SAT / ACT
  • Standardized test scores optional — the 2026–27 Stern bulletin states this for the 2024–25 application cycle
  • Stern applicants who submit three AP or three IB Higher Level scores (non-IB Diploma candidates) as their testing must include one mathematics exam, one literature/humanities exam and one exam in any subject

The Stern bulletin (2026–2027 edition) still names the 2024–25 cycle for the test-optional statement and refers to the NYU Admissions website for the full policy. The current NYU policy page could not be checked: NYU’s admissions pages returned HTTP 403 to automated checks on 2026-10-19.

Details
NYU’s admissions team is familiar with different global curricula; Stern encourages the most rigorous math available, which may include A-Level Mathematics.

The Stern bulletin does not say how A-Levels are assessed for admission (its A-Level tables are credit after enrolling, not admission). NYU’s international applicants page could not be checked: NYU’s admissions pages returned HTTP 403 to automated checks on 2026-10-19.

IB requirements
Overall score
Not recorded
Details
Applicants who are not IB Diploma candidates may submit three IB Higher Level scores as their standardized testing (one mathematics, one literature/humanities, one any subject). Stern encourages Higher Level Math where available.

Partial: the bulletin defers to the NYU Admissions website for the full testing policy, and its test-optional statement names the 2024–25 cycle; NYU’s own testing page could not be checked: NYU’s admissions pages returned HTTP 403 to automated checks on 2026-10-19. Treatment of the full IB Diploma in admission is not stated.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement: three AP Exam scores may be submitted as standardized testing — one mathematics, one literature/humanities, one any subject
  • AP exams must be taken before senior year to count in the admissions cycle

Partial: from the 2026–2027 Stern bulletin; NYU’s standardized tests page could not be checked: NYU’s admissions pages returned HTTP 403 to automated checks on 2026-10-19. AP credit after enrolling is not recorded here.

Other requirements
  • Apply through NYU Undergraduate Admissions with the Common Application, selecting a Stern programme (BS in Business, BS in Business and Political Economy, or BS in Business, Technology and Entrepreneurship) on the application
  • Personal essays and a recommendation are part of the review
